JET.label: JET pulse 42976 (1997, D-T)
JET.note: ELM-free hot-ion H-mode at 13.13 s, measured, not stationary. P = P_heat - dW/dt (thermal loss power). kappa is the vertical elongation; the source gives no kappa_a. M = 2.5 for n_T/(n_D + n_T) = 0.49-0.59. tau_measured is the thermal confinement time.
JET.source: Keilhacker et al., Nucl. Fusion 39, 209 (1999), Table II

ITER.label: ITER Q = 10 reference
ITER.note: Design values of the ITER standard inductive operation; a = 0.32 R from the published inverse aspect ratio.
ITER.source: Doyle et al., Nucl. Fusion 47, S18 (2007), section 5.3.4

SPARC.label: SPARC full-field H-mode (design)
SPARC.note: Design values. n is the volume-averaged density of Table 2 (no line average is given). The loss power is not published; P = 28.7 MW is the value at which IPB98(y,2) with H = 1 returns the published tau_E = 0.77 s.
SPARC.source: Creely et al., J. Plasma Phys. 86, 865860502 (2020), Tables 1-2 and section 3
